title: Choose the visual world
question: A bolder hand. The cape leads. An arcade marquee row is held back if you re-roll again.

options.label: The Drawcord Cape
options.lineage: One black silk semicircle gathered by a single gold cord
options.thesis: The career is the cloth. One pull gathers it into the job he holds now.
options.viewport: The silk fills the screen. Stitched across it: MOHD SOHEL DESHMUKH. The gathered volume reads Senior Software Engineer, Biz4Solutions, April 2025 – Present. The cord locks on deshmukh.sohel@yahoo.com. Home, Work, Contact ride the stitch channels. Earlier roles sit flat in the cloth.
options.risk: Reads as fashion before it reads as a person you can hire.

raised.raise: One pull displaces the entire cloth. Earlier roles are pushed outward, not listed beside it.
The present role lifts off the silk. Earlier roles stay flat in the weave.

options.label: The Provenance Ribbon
options.lineage: One red silk ribbon through every place a record has been
options.thesis: Employment is custody. The ribbon runs from 2017 to the job he holds, and the email is the present end.
options.viewport: Buff ground, one red ribbon from March 2017 to now. Folds: Software Engineer, Softworx; Programmer, Biz4Solutions; Senior Programmer; then April 2025 – Present, Senior Software Engineer. The name is set at the start. The email is the ribbon’s current claim.
options.case: Beats the cape on both counts. A recruiter can follow dated jobs, and the present end is the email.
options.risk: Turns a living engineer into an object in a museum.

options.label: The Cutting Bench
options.lineage: A film select rail, frames on pins, a tape flag where you stopped
options.thesis: The career is a work print. The flag marks the role he holds now, and you scrub the rail.
options.viewport: A perforated rail across a black sheet. Frames: 2017 Softworx, 2019 Programmer, 2022 Senior Programmer. The flagged frame is April 2025 – Present, Senior Software Engineer, Biz4Solutions, Mohd Sohel Deshmukh. The email sits in that frame’s white window.
options.case: Holds clarity: the flag is the current job and the rail is the drag. It loses the audience. A cutting bench is an editor’s tool, not a hiring scene.
options.risk: Orange-on-black becomes a poster if the frames stop being a rail you can scrub.

options.label: Floated Pigment
options.lineage: Pigment combed on a bath and lifted once onto paper
options.thesis: Each role is a ring pushed outward by the next drop.
options.viewport: Rings of pigment, the newest drop labeled with the current role.
options.case: Rings do not state an employer a recruiter can read.
options.kept: One pull displaces the whole surface.
options.risk: Beautiful, and the job disappears into the pattern.

options.label: The Collective Plate
options.lineage: A shared symbol set, hard edges, a corner mark
options.thesis: The current role is the symbol that hovers. The name sits in the corner.
options.viewport: Cobalt, magenta, and lemon figures. One symbol hovers. A corner mark.
options.case: A pseudonym grammar fights a real name, and the symbols do not carry the jobs.
options.kept: The present role lifts clear of the ground. Earlier roles stay flat.
options.risk: An art plate with a résumé pasted on.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer portfolio this category always ships: a dark hero, a name, two buttons, then cards.
canonCard.viewport: Centered hello, the full name, a Senior Software Engineer badge, Get in Touch and View Resume, gradient orbs behind. The next section is a row of equal cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other engineer template, including the site as it stands.
